caption: The drawing depicts a single metal spur, oriented horizontally on a plain, light beige or off-white background. The spur is rusted and colored in shades of dark brown and gray, with visible areas of oxidation and rough texture, indicating age and wear. It consists of a U-shaped band designed to fit around the heel, with two rectangular slots at either end, likely for attaching straps. At the back of the band, there is a protruding arm terminating in a star-shaped rowel with six sharply pointed, evenly spaced spikes. The details of the metal, including rivets and the construction of the hinge holding the rowel, are clearly rendered. There is a small, neat signature “W. Kieckhöfel” in the bottom right corner.
title: Spur
